module_summary: AXI-Lite read to simple register-interface bridge: latches the read address, drives reg_rd_en until ack or timeout counter expiry, then returns registered read data with rvalid.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read address valid captured when no request pending

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Ready when no read request is held

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Registered read data returned to AXI-Lite master

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read response valid, set on ack or timeout

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid_reg
anchors.why: Pending-request flag; blocks new address capture and drives reg_rd_en

anchors.name: reg_rd_addr
anchors.why: Register-interface address from latched AXI address

anchors.name: reg_rd_en
anchors.why: Register read request held until ack or timeout

anchors.name: reg_rd_data
anchors.why: Register read data captured into rdata register

anchors.name: reg_rd_ack
anchors.why: Register ack completing read and setting rvalid

anchors.name: reg_rd_wait
anchors.why: Wait input pausing the timeout countdown

anchors.name: timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Timeout counter forcing read completion when expired

groups.description: AR and R channel handshakes with registered response

groups.name: Read request control
groups.description: Holds pending request, issues reg_rd_en, completes on ack or timeout
